title: AI-assisted protein-family analysis identifies a tested toxin-antitoxin superfamily
summary: AI-predicted structural information helped researchers prioritize previously poorly characterized protein families. Experiments supported a translation-targeting toxin-antitoxin superfamily, TumE–TumA. This is one tested family-level result; the broader proposed families and predicted fold are not hundreds of separately validated discoveries. Native-organism function and general experimental validation across the predicted families remain unestablished.
ai_technology: AlphaFold structural models and DeepFRI functional prediction
organization: University of Basel; SIB Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics

evidence.tested: Selected proteins received laboratory functional validation.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and function of the broader computational candidate set were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold structural models and DeepFRI functional prediction supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.
